Name: (FS) Yankee Hat
Author: VoidWitchCult
Description:
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zD09S1Rm/title2-1-mod-details.png[/img]
﻿
Are you tired of wanting a proper Yankee in the game? Do you think to yourself that in the summer you want to wear your Yankee but you want the sun to sting your eyes? Well, look no further! This little Fashion Sense Pack includes a small variety of Yankees for every occasion!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Fashion Sense.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
